data.name: Graig
data.gender_notes: Graig is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old Welsh 'gwragedd' meaning spear or rod. This name was borne by several Welsh and Scottish saints. In Welsh mythology, the name was given to a guardian of the wild boar. The name Graig carries the meaning “Powerful spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Graig usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Graig total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
